A practical Shopify redesign checklist

Start with the shopping journey, then decide what needs to change.

Start with a problem

Write down the reason for the redesign. Is it difficult to find a product? Is the product information unclear? Are customers missing the personalisation controls? A useful brief connects every major design change to a real issue.

Map the important pages

Review the homepage, navigation, collections, search, product page and cart together. Improving one page while leaving the next step confusing can move the problem rather than solve it.

Design with real content

Use your longest product names, real photography, actual variants and complete delivery information. A layout that works only with short sample text is not ready to ship.

Check the whole journey

Test from the first visit through to the cart. Include sold-out variants, invalid inputs, long names and returning to a previous step. Keep a record of what you tested.

Measure after launch

Agree on the measures before launch and compare equivalent periods. Conversion changes have many possible causes, including traffic quality, pricing and promotions; do not credit the redesign without evidence.

By Fazal Bin Mahmood · Xylo Solutions. Adapt this checklist to your store and verify changes before publishing.
